A newer scan is available.

Healthcare organizations that received a federal NPI number in the last 90 days with a practice address in the territory - the earliest public sign of a new practice, clinic or agency. Source: the free CMS NPI Registry (checked 2026-10-31 12:34). Click a name for the official record.

Worth knowing: an NPI is issued when an organization applies - some are new businesses, some are existing practices registering a new location or a new legal entity, and a few never open. A brand-new LLC with a person's name and a residential address is usually a solo practitioner starting out. "Equipment, pharmacy & labs" is hidden by default: that group is full of tiny medical-supply LLCs that are rarely real opportunities.
